notes.title: Update Demo-version
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058884/f13274abf03807f642880a66f981c1d62ead2c3a.png

We made some fixes to the demo and want you to check it out:
1) The tutorial has been completely reworked. Less text, more action :)
2) We added autocast as an option for hero action skills.
3) Added a planning line for using skills and consumables during the active pause.
4) Some balance improvements (you will like it).
5) Some small bug fixes.

Thanks for all your feedback, it helps a lot. 
And like always - Roguelike?.. Rogue like a Greek, Traveler ;)

notes.title: FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT
notes.content:
Hey, heroes!

We’ve heard your requests, and we’re thrilled to announce that Run Heroes Run now fully supports controllers on all platforms! Whether you’re wielding a trusty Xbox, PlayStation, or Steam Deck controller, you can now enjoy smooth and immersive gameplay without needing to reach for the keyboard.

Key Features of Controller Support:


Streamlined Controls: All in-game actions are now optimized for your controller, allowing for a more intuitive and responsive experience.
Seamless Interface Navigation: Effortlessly manage your heroes, items, and abilities through our redesigned controller-friendly interface.


We can’t wait for you to experience the game in a whole new way. Try it out, and let us know what you think in the discussions or through a review! ⚔️

As always, thank you for your continued support. Keep running, heroes!
